environment: Ubuntu 24.04.1 under WSL 2, Node 22.23.3, Playwright 1.56.0, WebKit 26.0
method: A scratch clone with WebKit tolerances and mixDeterminism 0. The test 'seeded multi-voice mixes match within the engine mix tolerance' (audio-render-browser.test.js) ran with PI_AUDIO_ENGINES=webkit, 20 times at 09c4186 and 6 times at 48bb54f.
conclusion: WebKit multi-voice mixes are not bit-identical between page loads. Every difference is the same 4.88e-7, the size Chromium shows (4.8e-7) from its address-dependent input order. The E6 trial's pass at 0 (linux-webkit-audio.json) was one lucky run. No library source changed between the two revisions. WebKit uses Chromium's mixDeterminism, 2e-6.
